## History

Rogerson was a Sunday-school teacher who taught a class attended by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). During their lesson, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) felt completely out of place in her class.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rogerson.md)

Miss Rogerson acts as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's Sunday-school teacher. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends her class alone while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ultimately feels out of place during the lesson.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
